Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Bradhurst Rustic Wood Dining Table, 86.6"L, Brown
Colors: Brown
Materials: Hardwood
You'll enjoy years of making family memories around this modern rustic table. With a natural finish that shows off the wood's natural grain, it will add simple beauty to a farmhouse-style room. Angular cross-tied legs give it a modern touch. 86.6"L x 37.4"D x 30"H Hardwood made from fir A simple natural style that works with modern farmhouse or transitional décor A handsome table that can also be used in home office or as a craft table Assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
